android.desc: VPN with free and paid options! Get fast, private, and secure access to global content. SERVERLESS Our innovative use of serverless computing for VPN gives you the cost benefit with the same fast, private, and secure capabilities of the WireGuard VPN protocol. WHAT’S INCLUDED? - Unlimited devices in all plans - 30-day money-back guarantee - Works on Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, iOS, tvOS, iPadOS, Raspberry Pi OS, Chrome OS - Global locations PAY AS YOU GO | PREPAID PLAN - The perfect plan if you use VPN occasionally - Your prepaid balance never expires - Each VPN session is charged $0.02/hr + $0.05/GB + $0.05 base - Pricing calculator: https://UpVPN.app/pricing/#pricing-calculator - 5 concurrent VPN sessions YEARLY PLAN - The perfect plan for when you need unlimited VPN usage - Unlimited data - 7 concurrent VPN sessions OPEN SOURCE YOU CAN TRUST UpVPN desktop and mobile apps have been open source since day one. https://github.com/upvpn/upvpn-app WEB DEVICES Get a VPN server without the hassle of managing servers or VPN configurations using Web Device feature. This way, UpVPN service can be used with official WireGuard apps using the Web Device feature, even on routers with WireGuard support! You manage VPN sessions of these devices on our dashboard - we call such devices Web Devices. HOW DOES SERVERLESS VPN WORK? A VPN server is provisioned on-demand when you connect and deprovisioned when you disconnect. In fully serverless locations, indicated by blue color, you get a new server and IP on demand with just one tap. In locations where we have available server capacity, indicated by green color, you can connect quickly.
